messages:
elle: Thanks team — quick follow-up from the DB fail postmortem. I made a remediation list and queued Jira tickets. Need owners + ETA so we can close the loop.

sam: Thanks. can you drop the ticket numbers? I'll pick up the 'connection pool default' one if it's not taken.

elle: Sure — tickets: DB-4027 (pool defaults), DB-4031 (client-side retry), OBS-210 (improve query tracing). I added short descriptions. @sam assigning DB-4027 to you. ETA 2 weeks?

sam: Yep 2 weeks works. I'll set up a short RFC and link it to DB-4027.

ash: I can take OBS-210. I'll coordinate with infra to add span tagging. ETA end of next sprint. @elle want this RACI-aligned (R:ash, A:elle, C:logging, I:devx)?

elle: Yes that's perfect. Add the RACI in the Jira description; we'll keep RACI at ticket-level for remediation work.

mike: I can own DB-4031 (client retry). Quick Q: should retries be only in the client or also have server-side backoff? I want to avoid duplicate behavior.

elle: Good call — make it client-first with optional server-provided Retry-After; document in the ticket.

ria: I noticed this pattern has happened 3x in the last 6 months (high tail latency -> connection exhaustion). Can we add a recurring detection alert? I suggest a weekly runbook check and a metric-based alert PDIF-conn-exhaust.

sam: Agreed. I'll add a follow-up ticket OPS-789 to add the alert and a test harness.

oncall-bot: incident: DB outage 2026-03-22 09:12 UTC — alert created PD-1256, runbook link https://wiki/redwood/runbooks/db-conn-exhaust

elle: Thanks @oncall-bot. Action owners: DB-4027 @sam, DB-4031 @mike, OBS-210 @ash, OPS-789 @sam. I'll own cross-ticket verification and sign-off. Let's sync next Tue 9:30am PT for handoff and dependencies.

sam: calendar invite incoming. I'll add the ticket links and a short checklist for handoff.

ash: I'll drop a pre-read (traces + span plan) by EOD Monday.

mike: I'll draft the retry strategy doc and post to the ticket by Friday.

elle: Great. I'll mark this thread as the accountability queue reference and update the postmortem doc with the ticket table. :white_check_mark:

ria: tiny ask — can we capture expected SLO changes in the tickets? helps the QA/infra sign-off.

elle: Added to the checklist. thanks!
